findings.claim: The new `build-install` target's help comment is labeled `## build:` (line 81), duplicating the existing `## build:` label already used by the real `build` target (line 69) — `make help` greps `^##` and columns the first field as the command name, so it now prints two rows both headed "build", the second actually describing `build-install`. Every other target in this Makefile keeps the `## <name>:` comment in sync with its own `.PHONY`/target name (`## build-release:`, `## test-coverage:`, `## installer-check:`, etc.) — this is the one place the label diverges from the real target, breaking that convention and `make help`'s output for this entry.
findings.fix: Change the comment to `## build-install: build all binaries and install` so it matches the `.PHONY: build-install` / `build-install: build` target below it.
findings.evidence: Re-read Makefile via `git show 1f725cedc5c8b092c8a3d7e408793ef72840ec7e:Makefile`: line 69 `## build: build all binaries` (target `build`, line 71-79); line 81 `## build: build all binaries and install` immediately followed by `.PHONY: build-install` / `build-install: build` (lines 82-84) — confirmed the label collides with the unrelated `build` target and does not name its own target, the only such mismatch in the file's `## <name>:` convention.

findings.claim: In the new skill-visibility block's non-casual ("drop overrides") branch, the exact same jq filter program (`if .skillOverrides then .skillOverrides = (.skillOverrides | with_entries(select(.key as $k | $leaves | index($k) | not))) else . end | if .skillOverrides == {} then del(.skillOverrides) else . end`) is written out twice verbatim — once against `$SETTINGS_FILE` (lines 288-291) and once against `$REPO_LOCAL_SETTINGS` (lines 295-298) — instead of being factored into a one-line helper function taking the target file as a parameter, the way `sync_file()`/`merge_mcp_servers()` elsewhere in this same file already factor repeated file-rewrite logic.
findings.fix: Extract a `strip_skill_overrides() { local f="$1"; jq --argjson leaves "$leaf_names_json" '...' "$f" > "$f.tmp" && mv "$f.tmp" "$f"; }` helper and call it for both `$SETTINGS_FILE` and `$REPO_LOCAL_SETTINGS`.
findings.evidence: Re-read cmd/sync/sync_skills.sh via `git show 1f725cedc5c8b092c8a3d7e408793ef72840ec7e:cmd/sync/sync_skills.sh`, lines 286-301: confirmed the two `if [ -f ... ]; then jq --argjson leaves ... '<identical filter>' ... fi` blocks are byte-identical apart from the file variable, back to back in the same `else` branch — a genuine copy-paste, not merely similar logic.

findings.claim: The presentation-profile parsing + dev-mode derivation block (read `presentation-profile.md`, extract `profile_language`/`profile_audience`/`profile_dev_mode`, then derive `dev_mode` from `SMINE_DEV_MODE`/profile/casual-override) is newly introduced in this diff in both `cmd/bootstrap/run.sh` (lines 55-66) and `routines/smine-nightly/run.sh` (lines 621-634) as near-identical, independently-maintained copies (differing only in `[ ]` vs `[[ ]]` test syntax) — a change to the dev-mode derivation rule (e.g. a third audience value) has to be made in both wrappers or they silently diverge.
findings.fix: Factor the profile-read + dev-mode derivation into a shared function in `routines/_lib/` (e.g. `routines/_lib/presentation.sh`, sourced by both `cmd/bootstrap/run.sh` and `routines/smine-nightly/run.sh`) that sets `profile_language`/`profile_audience`/`dev_mode`.
findings.evidence: Re-read both files via `git show 1f725cedc5c8b092c8a3d7e408793ef72840ec7e:cmd/bootstrap/run.sh` (lines 55-66) and `git show 1f725cedc5c8b092c8a3d7e408793ef72840ec7e:routines/smine-nightly/run.sh` (lines 621-634), and confirmed via the base→head diff that the smine-nightly block is new in this change (previously presentation_profile was read later, only for the consolidate-language branch) — so this is a fresh duplication introduced by this diff, not pre-existing debt merely touched in passing.
